Blocks.Text: Important

All unversioned (v2) API deprecation deadlines are extended to July 2028 to provide additional flexibility for partner integration teams. Connect with your LinkedIn Business Development partner before planning migration work.
All support references across LTS documentation that previously directed partners to Zendesk (linkedin.zendesk.com) have been updated to use the new partner support form.

New: Verifications - LinkedIn-issued identity and workplace trust signals are now available for both apply surfaces: Apply Connect with Verifications adds verificationData to the existing job application webhook payload, and Apply with LinkedIn with Verifications delivers a signed verificationData block to off-site applications. See the Verification data schema for the shared data model.
RSC: The applications resource path changed from /rest/atsApplications to /rest/applications. For details, refer to RSC Release Notes — Version 202604.
Recommended Matches and Unified Search sunset timeline
Starting December 2025, support for these widgets will end for:

New RSC partners.
Existing RSC partners when they move to the versioned Job Requisitions APIs.
Because some components of these widgets depend on the unversioned Job Postings API, both widgets will be sunset in line with the unversioned API sunset date of July 31, 2028.

RSC: New optional vanityIdentifier field added to jobRequisitions. See RSC Release Notes — Version 202603 for details.
CRM Connect: Pipeline endpoints updated. See CRM Connect Release Notes for details.
API versioning page updated: The LinkedIn Talent API versioning page now includes a supported versions table with release and sunset dates, an API version history table with endpoint changes and release notes links, upcoming sunset dates, migration guidance, and an FAQ section.
⚠️ RSC: Breaking changes to candidates; integrations and integrationConfigurations renamed; data deletion APIs updated. See RSC Release Notes — Version 202602 for details.
RSC: seatsV2, candidateNotes, and applicationNotes APIs updated. See RSC Release Notes — Version 202512 for details.
RSC: entityAcls and entityAclAssignees migrated to versioned API. See RSC Release Notes — Version 202511 for details.

RSC: mailStubs and attachments APIs updated. See RSC Release Notes — Version 202510 for details.
RSC/CRM: New Child Application Secret Management APIs. See Application Secret Management for details.
RSC: applicationInterviewFeedbacks API updated. See RSC Release Notes — Version 202508.02 for details.
RSC: New attachments API for syncing resumes. See RSC Release Notes — Version 202508 for details.

⚠️ RSC: Breaking changes to simpleJobPostings and exportedCandidates; applicationStage migrated to flat resource path; new exportedApplicationEvaluations endpoint added; multiple APIs migrated to rest/ base path. See RSC Release Notes — Version 202507 for details.
RSC: New Job Requisitions APIs. See RSC Release Notes — Version 202504 for details.

A new API version 202504 is released as part of the April 2025 LinkedIn Talent APIs update. It aligns with the March 2025 updates, uses the base path https://api.linkedin.com/rest/, and includes no specific changes to the January 2025 APIs.

LinkedIn’s Talent APIs are transitioning to a versioned API release cycle starting with the January 2025 release under a new base path: https://api.linkedin.com/rest/, see LTS API Documentation Versioning.

Apply With LinkedIn

Beginning May 1, 2022, we will replace the current cookie-based Apply with LinkedIn experience with an OAuth model. Candidate consent will now be handled within the OAuth flow. We do not expect partners to do any work. The below images display the non-staffing and staffing variant of the consent screen.

Beginning May 1, 2022, we will deprecate BUTTON and DATA mode. Multiple page flows like the Standard Flow and Create Account flow can still be supported but will require persisting profile data in the first page. Here's how a multi-page flow will look like with BUTTON_DATA mode: The Apply With LinkedIn widget in BUTTON_DATA mode is rendered on the first page of the job apply flow Candidate clicks the Apply With LinkedIn button LinkedIn sends the candidate's profile data to the callback method specified in the widget Partner stores/caches the LinkedIn profile data from the callback If the candidate's profile data needs to be populated on any subsequent pages, the partner uses the stored LinkedIn profile data from the first page When the candidate submits the job application, the partner loads the Apply With LinkedIn widget in CONVERSION mode

Job Posting API -

Introduced workplaceTypes field in job posting schema to mark workplace nature of jobs. This field will be available for use by January 4, 2022
Revised description to include recommended value formats for location field
All partners need to adopt the latest Job Posting API's Schema by November 1, 2022. This means all partners should stop using fields mentioned in table below and marked with '*' in the schema document.
A consolidated summary of the changes that the API partner needs to take care of is given below:
Job Posting API

Rows.Text: postalCode field will be deprecated. We recommend using the location field instead
countryCode field will be deprecated. We recommend using the location field instead
workRemoteAllowed field will be deprecated. We recommend using the workplaceTypes field instead. This field will be available for use by January 4, 2022

state field will be deprecated. We recommend using the jobPostingOperationType field instead. Thus, the state.listed field should be replaced by jobPostingOperationType.create and state.closed field should be replaced by jobPostingOperationType.close field

A value greater than 180 will not be allowed for the expireAt field. ATS should display to customers that the life of the job posting on LinkedIn will be 180 days and reflect the status as CLOSED on LinkedIn after 180 days. Once the job posting is closed on LinkedIn, it will be good to provide customers the support to RENEW the job posting or configure Auto-Renew in which case, ATS/Partner can renew the jobs proactively after 180 days if the job posting is still in LIVE/OPEN state on partner platform
